A [[human]] served to the [[Galactic Empire]] as an '''executive officer''' with the [[military rank]]<ref name="Daughter" /> of [[commander]]<ref name="Rank">{{ImperialRanks-PreDS-LA}}</ref> alongside [[Captain]] [[Elk]] on a [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]].<ref name="Daughter" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"Daughter of Ferrix" takes place shortly after "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," which {{SW|url=andor-s1-e8-trivia-gallery|text="Narkina 5" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 6}} dates to [[5 BBY]].</ref> the [[Starship|ship]] [[Skirmish above Segra Milo|encountered]] the [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|V-21.1 Chevlex]] of the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]] and caught it in a [[tractor beam]].<ref name="Daughter" />
